id.description: Base ID for the radio group. Each radio's ID will be this base plus the option's id or index.

tile.description: Render each radio as a tile when true

hint.description: Group-level hint text, rendered after the legend

error.description: Group-level error message, rendered after the hint

name.description: Name attribute for the radio inputs

defaultValue.description: Value of the option to be selected by default

onChange.description: React change handler for the selected radio input.

fieldset.description: Wrap options in a fieldset; false allows one option inside a table cell.

formGroup.description: Wrap the fieldset in a form group.

options.description: Array of option objects: {id, value, label, ariaLabel, description, checked, disabled}

className.description: Additional classes to apply to the wrapper
